baseline.newAccountsUsually: An account under a year old moves three to fifteen payments a month, to eight or fewer people.
baseline.passThroughUsually: Most personal accounts hold money for days, not minutes.
baseline.deviceSharingUsually: Sharing a device with another customer happens, mostly inside a family.

context.note: Every account is judged on its own neighbourhood. Nothing in the state says which cluster an account belongs to.
